candidates: TopicUser.find_by can return nil and notification_level can be NULL, which will raise an error when calling tu.notification_level or comparing it, breaking unsubscribe for users without a topic_users row
Template renders a computed property named stopNotificiationsText with a typo via triple-stash - should render the translation directly with the existing i18n helper instead

The unsubscribe endpoint is wired as a GET route but mutates server state (updates TopicUser.notification_level), making it CSRF-able and violating the expectation that GET requests are side-effect free - should use POST/PUT with CSRF protection or require a signed one-click token

The new unsubscribe action lacks accompanying controller/request specs to prevent regressions - needs coverage for creating missing TopicUser row, updating notification_level, and canonical redirect when slug is missing/mismatched
The scope chain indentation is off, making it easy to miss that the second where is part of the scope and can trip style/linting

Controller file ends with }) and includes a trailing comma after the last property, which is inconsistent with other controllers and can cause issues with older JS runtimes/linting - should use }); terminator and no trailing comma
